depiction_rules.notes: D027 serpent king, a continuous churning rope distinct from Adishesha.

visual_bible.form: one continuous powerful serpent with one head and a clearly identifiable tapering tail
visual_bible.surface: matte muted olive, cream and earth-blue patterning, simple drawn scales
visual_bible.role: one continuous churning rope wrapped around Mandara; asuras hold its single head end, devas hold its tail end; poison fumes emerge only from the head

anatomy_contract.rule: head held by asuras and tail by devas where churning is shown

never: no additional heads or duplicate body
no severed coils or detached/forked tail
identity_scope: D027 scene continuity only; not an approved character master
